description:
*From [INKR Comics](https://comics.inkr.com/title/1257-painful-dating):*    
The timid Na Jiwoo wants to break up with his scary girlfriend, so he lied about joining the army.  
After that, he gets a part-time job, but as if by fate, his co-worker is his girlfriend's roommate.  
Jiwoo must now hide his identity in front of his girlfriend while his co-worker is crushing on him.

**Original Webtoon:**  
[Naver Series](https://series.naver.com/comic/detail.series?productNo=8530118), [MrBlue](https://www.mrblue.com/webtoon/wt_000052790), [Lezhin](https://www.lezhin.com/ko/comic/painful_love)

**Official Translations:**     
English ([Dashtoon](https://dashtoon.com/comics/read/SHOkOFeXuNGrPzoiKZS), [HyperComic](https://play.hypercomic.io/Webtoon/episode/70/), [MangaPlaza](https://mangaplaza.com/title/0303011514/)), [Japanese](https://www.amazon.co.jp/-/en/dp/B0BTJFFN95/)
